target: For every positive definite complex Toeplitz matrix T of size n+1 and every prescribed unit-circle node z, construct a positive rank-sized atomic representation containing z. Deduce that every full-rank PSD Toeplitz matrix has distinct positive rank-sized supports, and characterize uniqueness of supported positive finite data exactly by rank(T)<=n. Claim only completed statements.
conventions: Original entry orientation T_ij=sum w(z)*conj(z^i)*z^j; finite supports give distinct nodes; positive real weights; compare weights only on support. Full-rank representations have n+1 nodes.
DH_analogue: Identical generic finite linear algebra for DH-derived matrices satisfying the PSD/Toeplitz hypotheses. No arithmetic PSD input, scan, or separator.
